title: LB David retires as one of Bucs' all-time greats

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: LB David retires as one of Bucs' all-time greats
sources.description: Linebacker Lavonte David announced his retirement Tuesday after a 14-year career with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in which he was a 12-time captain and has led the league in tackles since he entered the NFL.
